project_name.justification: Dark Star Minerals Inc. ... is pleased to announce that it has entered into a non-binding Letter of Intent dated March 31, 2025 ("LOI") with two arms length vendors (together, the "Vendors") to acquire a 100% interest in the Bleasdell Lake uranium project (the "Bleasdell Project" or "Project")

company_name.justification: DARK STAR MINERALS INC. (CSE: BATT) (FSE: P0W) (the "Company" or "Dark Star") is pleased to announce that it has entered into a non-binding Letter of Intent...

ceo_buyer.justification: "said Marc Branson, President, Chief Executive Officer and a director of Dark Star."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: ...to acquire a 100% interest in the Bleasdell Lake uranium project (the "Bleasdell Project" or "Project")

primary_commodity.justification: Dark Star Announces Acquisition of Uranium Project with Historical Resource in Northern Saskatchewan

verified_article_link.justification: The article describes the acquisition of the Bleasdell Project by Dark Star Minerals Inc., which matches the primary project of interest.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Dark Star Minerals Inc., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE: BATT) and the consideration includes payments in '$' and a share price in '$', implying Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of three tranches: "a cash payment of $25,000 from Dark Star to the Vendors within five (5) days of the execution of the LOI; a cash payment of $75,000 from Dark Star to the Vendors within fifteen (15) days of receipt by Dark Star of approval from the Canadian Securities Exchange...; a cash payment of $150,000 from Dark Star to the Vendors within six (6) months of the entry into of a definitive agreement..."

share_payments_raw.justification: No explicit total dollar value for the share payment is provided. The consideration is described in terms of number of shares and a deemed price per share.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text provides separate components for cash and share payments, but not a single combined total value for the transaction.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: the issuance of 5,000,000 common shares (each, a "Share") of Dark Star...

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the acquisition terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options are mentioned as part of the acquisition terms.

issued_share_price.justification: ...at a deemed price per Share equal to the greater of: (i) $0.06 per Share; and (ii) the lowest permitted price per Share pursuant to the policies of the CSE...

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text mentions "Drill Permits are pending for 4,000 meters", but this is not a binding commitment required as part of the acquisition terms, which are listed separately under "The Letter of Intent".

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment is mentioned as part of the acquisition terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms include "the granting a 2.0% net smelter return royalty on the Project in favour of the Vendors".

coverage_area_raw.justification: ...the Bleasdell Lake uranium project (the "Bleasdell Project" or "Project") consisting of over 515 Hectares in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada...

coverage_area_unit.justification: ...consisting of over 515 Hectares in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada...

resource_size.justification: The text states: "The Project has had significant historic exploration and development including a historic deposit consisting of 620,700 lbs of U3O8..." The article clarifies this is a historical estimate and not a current mineral resource.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified in the first paragraph as "DARK STAR MINERALS INC. (CSE: BATT)".
